evidence.reason: render_units deduplicates neither source paths nor basenames: it recursively lists all files under systemd/, selects templates by basename, then writes each rendered template to output / source.name. Two distinct sources with the same basename, such as crq-repair.service and extra/crq-repair.service, therefore collide on one output path; the later atomic_bytes call silently overwrites the earlier unit, and paths contains the same target twice. That makes verification inspect the surviving file repeatedly rather than detect the missing unit. Rejecting duplicate basenames before any writes is the smallest correct fix and leaves unique basenames unaffected.
